title: Steam local client data
whyItMatters: Steam keeps the local account list, cloud-save data and client state in this folder. It shows which Steam accounts were signed in and what was played on this Mac.
source: Steam Support, Removing and Reinstalling Steam on a Mac: Steam data is in Library/Application Support/Steam - https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/30EB-87BF-531F-512D
notes: Includes userdata, which holds one folder per Steam account that signed in, plus local save data. Installed games may sit in this folder or on another drive; custom library folders are not matched.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy any game saves kept only on this Mac, since some titles do not use Steam Cloud.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Steam and remove this Mac from the authorized devices in Steam Guard settings.
steps: On the Steam website, open Account Details, then Authorized Devices, and choose Sign out everywhere.
Uninstall Steam by moving it to the Trash.
Delete the folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local client state and cached sign-in from this Mac. Games, licences and cloud saves stay with the Steam account.
